comment: The declared set of mobile device flows: what the mobile pillar promises, one object each, so the ratio mobile_flow_pass_rate is a quotient of this file and the JUnit the mobile job writes, and not a number somebody remembers. runs names the repository that owns the spec: this one, or platformkit-mobile, whose four flows remain hand-run and are on that repository's own list to put behind the harness scripts/mobile_e2e.sh shows. A flow with runs: platformkit that does not appear in that JUnit as a pass makes the job fail.
